releases.displayName: Funguys Swarm Optimization Update OUT NOW!

items.text: HEY Funguys!
Welcome to the March 2026 Funguys Swarm Dev Update!
Our fifth major update, the Optimization Update, is live now!

In this announcement, we’ll showcase major CPU usage improvements in the arena, introduce in-game graphic settings, go over quality-of-life improvements, highlight several gameplay changes, and finish with balance updates.
Many players informed us that the game can slow down significantly during large swarms — especially in the late game.
In extreme situations, the game could drop to very low FPS and even freeze for several seconds.

We've spent the last few months optimizing the core swarm simulation, and the improvement is huge. Large battles should now remain much smoother and far more stable, even when the arena becomes chaotic.
Performance Comparison (on Steam Deck)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/62b1e77128276905666e37d441fa21bdb128b45f.png"]
What does this mean for you?
Massive swarms should feel much smoother.
Frame drops recover much faster.
Long freezes should no longer happen.
Even in the most chaotic moments, performance now recovers within 1–2 seconds.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/0c8841b89e18254aef8e9316135dd6a5f25c316e.gif"]
Sometimes you want to keep it light, we get it. You can now adjust graphics in the settings via the Quality Preset option.

Enemy Outline toggle: Show / Hide character outlines
Enemy Ground Splatter toggle: Show / Hide Enemy Ground Splatter.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/f972f0169a18a55a264fd4982a3a939bb2231c70.gif"]\[Therapy for bad RNG]
Banish no longer ends your level-up immediately. You can now banish multiple cards before selecting your upgrade.

Dew, Shroom, and XP now spawn as breakable objects again instead of Shrines. Each requires 3 hits from any source to break.

That’s all for now, folks.

items.text: Hi everyone!

This patch focuses on reducing the difficulty spikes and grind in Starpath quests that many of you have felt. Weapons, characters, and skills now unlock much earlier, giving you more freedom to experiment and discover fun builds.

Runs should feel smoother and less restrictive from the start. We’ve also adjusted overall difficulty so it’s easier to reach builds that feel strong and satisfying. We hope that every run feels rewarding, without slowing you down or getting in the way of the fun.

Hey everyone!
We know the recent 0.5 update made the game harder than intended. It could feel too grindy, and player choices didn’t matter as much as they should.
We’re very sorry about this. With this release, we’ve taken steps to fix these issues.

One of the most noticeable problems was how Amount scaling worked during a run. Before 0.5, it was possible to build around increasing skill projectile Amount, but in 0.5 those builds were almost non-existent. This was caused by a design issue in how Amount cards were calculated to appear, giving them a significantly lower chance compared to other upgrade cards. This has been corrected in this release.

Damage scaling had also drifted too far from the pre-0.5 balance. With this update, we’ve brought it closer to the original experience so that player power scales correctly with enemy strength, as originally intended.

The damage scaling issue in 0.5 also made it harder to kill enemies, which caused them to pile up on screen and significantly impacted performance. While this update doesn’t completely resolve all performance issues, it should bring performance closer to what it was previously. We’re also planning a dedicated optimization patch in our future update.

Finally, regarding progression: the higher difficulty in 0.5 reduced the chances of successfully completing Starpath quests, making progression feel frustratingly slow. With this release, progression should be back to its intended pace.
Patch Notes 0.5.1 - Gameplay Calculation Adjustment

The calculations that determine the appearance chance of Amount Upgrade Cards have been redesigned. This issue caused the Amount attribute to have a significantly lower chance compared to other attributes, resulting in player power being much lower than intended.
Damage upgrade rarity values for all Skill Cards have been increased to better reflect older values.
All weapons now correctly have 5% Crit Chance and 150% Crit Damage by default.
Damage, Attack/Charge Speed, Crit Chance, and Crit Damage values for all Weapon Upgrade Cards have been increased.
Shrine spawn weights have been adjusted.
Reinforcement Fire Curse now spawns copies with 50% of the original enemy’s health. Copies now use a different colored outline to distinguish them from the original.
Frozen Pond slipperiness has been reduced, allowing more player control in the arena.

HEY Funguys!
[p align="initial"]Welcome to the January 2026 Funguys Swarm Dev Update!
[p align="initial"]Our fourth major update, the New Characters Update, is live now!

[p align="initial"]In this blog, we introduce six new characters and reveal a new system where skills and passives now have rarities. We’ll also cover new gameplay mechanics, including Shrines, Luck, and Armor.
[p align="initial"]Finally, we showcase brand-new content, such as fire curses and blessings.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/3966dc94b095e9064b9449599e20caa138734f7a.png"]
We're adding not 1, not 2, but 6 new characters this time!
Groovba: Debuffs deal +20% damage for each Nature card you have. Enemies killed by debuffs have a 2% chance to drop a half heart.
Joomba: After standing still for 3 seconds, gain +50% damage, plus +20% for each Sky card you have.
Fuzzbug: Start with 1 pixie that damages enemies. Pixies are affected by amount modifiers. Gain +1 projectile for every 2 Night cards you have.

X-Olotl: For every 5 Beast cards you have, spawn a copy of yourself that deals 50% of your weapon damage. Dash cooldown is reduced by 5% per Beast card. After you dash, gain +50% attack speed for 2 seconds.
NutsNBoltz: You can now find Nuts in the arena. Nuts charge your mecha by 20% and grant +50% movement speed for 5 seconds. Nut bonuses are increased for each Earth card you have.
Chimpy: Convert all HP into Armor. HP pickups no longer drop. Taking damage while armored causes an explosion, dealing 100 damage. Explosion damage increases by 20% for each Nature card you have.
Check out two of their many bonkers abilities
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_59081f4c151a47ed97a1a1e74e1e67fe~mv2.gif"]\[This is a bug. We will not fix it.]

items.text: HEY Funguys!
Welcome to the December 2025 Funguys Swarm Dev Update!
Our third major update, the Starpath Update, will go live on December 17 at 6:00 PM PST.
In this blog, we'll go over Steam capsule redesign, Shroomba and Ersa redesign, the progression overhaul, 6 new dash skills, 2 new skills, 5 treelings, and 3 new relics.
The new character, “NUTCASE,” is now featured on the capsule, and the vibe is more chaotic than ever.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/19aae87eb5172f1ca1749f0df153c42121ff47f9.png"]\[Shroomba, why so serious?]
We felt Shroomba and Ersa are too plain and cute for the new vibe we're aiming for, so we gave them a more fierce look.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/529219ba3a638c73f2d6c06d972f9c012c369d45.png"]
We hear you folks. Lots of you think the game is fun, but it's too short. Well, we're changing all that. We're revamping our entire achievement progressions!
[p align="initial"]We’re completely revamping the achievement progression system.
[p align="initial"]Previously, Starpath had 56 achievements. With this update, we’re adding 47 new achievements, bringing the total to 103 achievements to unlock.
[p align="initial"]The new progression gives you clearer goals to work toward, more milestones to chase, and rewards that feel more meaningful based on how far you’ve progressed.
[p align="initial"]Because this is a major change, all resources will be refunded for existing save files, so you can re-engage with the new system from a clean slate.
We're introducing not one, not two, but six new dash skills and two new skills!
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_08915957679346e3a8e2801a2bc09afc~mv2.gif"]\[Social distancing, but with dirt]
Your dash is replaced with a dig. On dash, you burrow underground and move forward until you emerge, dealing damage and knockback.
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_adb4feddca1d4af580648605201b7e4a~mv2.gif"]\
Your dash is replaced with ghost mode. On dash, you spawn a shadow-self and become an invulnerable ghost for a duration.
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_c8b28ad6bced41afba7ce44727f9c768~mv2.gif"]\[Talk to the fists]
On cooldown, you spawn 2 fists that punch forward, dealing damage and knocking back enemies.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45505085/a2a12ea6f2d1ad26e3ffb3497ad781290486f377.png"]\[Marathony is my favorite]

[p align="initial"]That’s all for now, folks. The next updates are already in the works, including:

[p align="initial"]More content and surprises: [p align="initial"]Expect more upgrades, balance tweaks, and maybe a few hidden treats along the way.

HEYO! Welcome to the October 2025 Funguys Swarm Dev Update!
Our first major update: Lava Jungle is here, let’s go bananas!
But, before that, we would like to thank you all for this achievement. Funguys Swarm just hit an Overwhelmingly Positive review on Steam!

[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_679be991b74e40b89eaefc7f4c4fc409~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_740,h_108,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/3da808_679be991b74e40b89eaefc7f4c4fc409~mv2.png"]
This time, we'll show you a more detailed view of the Lava Jungle, a more in-depth explanation of the new revamped weapon system, and our very first Mecha!
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_6d540738c4754b038ec5704d3d00b723~mv2.gif"]
Lava Jungle Arena is our hottest and most difficult level yet. The area is filled with pools of lava, where one wrong step will mean taking damage.
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_1aca215f8d3542cbbbde0bfef56b29b9~mv2.gif"]\[This floor is literally lava]
Standing in the lava will make your character glow red, and after a brief delay, you’ll start taking damage. Better save that dash while avoiding enemies, hah!
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_bae76dd1ff1446fe87d70c1b6a30b8f2~mv2.gif"]
\[Careful—this one’s on a molten mood swing.]
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_faf7acd018d74be78cac7c83907844ad~mv2.gif"]\[Head first, questions never]
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_5db1514a55c74ad9ba5e3f0c3110cfef~mv2.gif"]
\[Brings the party… and the aftermath.]

notes.title: It’s a bird! It’s a plane! No—it’s Potato Bot!

items.text: [img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_242dbde96dbd4d45a6f040e812c52d88~mv2.gif"]
\[Boom boom, keep shooting and feel the powahhh]
Lava Jungle hard? Don't worry! We gotchu fam.

Introducing Potato Bot, a powerful mecha bot that is unlocked once you unlock Lava Jungle Arena. You can jump while piloting Potato Bot and can shoot exploding potato bombs. Once the blue bar is charged, it will release a special attack.
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_5a5e8df2d5ab488d894229a5d2d58861~mv2.gif"]
There are 3 mecha charge bars. The bar charges automatically over time but fills faster as you defeat more enemies.
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_65b60475c5a3442f99925c1e0119f750~mv2.gif"]

Once at least one bar is charged, you can press the "Call Mecha" button to transform into Potato Bot. If you save up and charge multiple bars at once you get a bonus duration so you can stay in Potato Bot longer.
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/3da808_eb07b8d655d543fdacb83a5cabc9cc4d~mv2.gif"]
\[That’s what I call a smash potato!]

As you deal more damage to enemies, you’ll notice the blue bar filling up. This is the ultimate attack bar. Fill it up, and once it’s full, press the button to unleash the ultimate attack and cause absolute mayhem!
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_b268617ea97d40b5a14f1627c05528bb~mv2.gif"]
\[Sharp, stylish, and straight to the point—meet the Hornet Spike.]

Hornet Spike is a weapon for sharpshooter players. You can charge the Hornet to release a spike that travels farther than a normal one. All spikes pierce through enemies, allowing you to damage multiple foes at once, perfect for lined-up packs!
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_7ca88964077a458d937602788c8b2514~mv2.gif"]
We’ve reworked our weapon system! Now, every 3 levels, you can pick a Weapon Card to level up your weapon, and every 12 levels, you can choose a Weapon Mutation.
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_83354f852b9d4e518bf545535f45c717~mv2.gif"]
Every 3 levels, you will be able to pick a weapon card augment. Each weapon card augment can have a rarity of Common, Rare, or Epic. Higher rarities provide stronger stat upgrades.
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_cd3dcb1e07794653be13b9fe3e98d518~mv2.gif"]
Every 12 levels, you will be able to pick a weapon mutation.
[img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_4dd9de3735cf408fa21e3411ff373f0c~mv2.gif"]\[Gotta be, gotta be golden]

A weapon mutation is a powerful skill that lets you strengthen your playstyle. We’ve added 10 mutations for each weapon, allowing you to explore the many different possibilities offered by the new Weapon Card system.

notes.title: What mutating weapons means for your run

items.text: [img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/171fa5_26e2b6a6ba594813843b3b1b4a44a5d2~mv2.gif"]
Weapon Cards add variety and replayability to each run. You can create a build that relies on attack speed, or one that focuses on attack damage.
Each build relies on the augments and mutations to strengthen a particular playstyle.
We hope this adds even more variation to each run.

items.text: Hi Funguys,
Thank you so much for all the amazing feedback you’ve shared! We’ve been watching you dive into the fiery swarms, and it’s been a blast!

We’ve cooked up a hotfix based on what we’ve seen and heard to help make Funguys Swarm even better. Keep the feedback coming, you can drop it on our Steam discussions, hop into our Discord, or tag us on social media!
Thanks again for playing the Funguys Swarm demo, we hope you're having as much fun dying to the swarm beating the Appletini!
Grape Barrage: Your Grape weapon now throws an extra projectile.
Thunderspear: After a number of attacks, you spawn spears in front of you that stab enemies.
New skill progression: start with 2 skill slots, unlock 2 more every 10 levels, up to 6 total.
Skills now mutate at level 5 and level 10 (was level 4 and 7).
Passive cards reworked:
No longer upgradeable to Fire Level.
Can now level up to 10 (increased overall effects).
Hot Coal (Fire Skill) temporarily removed.
New icons for different Auto-Attack states.
Adjusted XP bean color variations.
Appletini now enters Rage Mode at 50% health.
Enemies now correctly move around Manafall crystals.
Auto-Aim system now correctly targets fire totems and special clutters.
Fixed special clutters not showing health bar when damaged.
Fixed Auto-Attack delay when an enemy enters attack range.
Stand In Circle challenge duration reduced:
Normal: 30s → 25s
Hard: 20s → 15s
Power-up durations (Haste, Amplify Damage, Invulnerability, Resources) reduced to 20s at max level.
Changed Encounter and Swarm timings for Carrot Farm
Balanced enemy health and movement speed
Stardust
Projectile amount: 4–6 → 4
XP drop chance: 10% → 1%–5%
TWINKLE STARS spawn chance: 5% → 1%
SPLITTING BOLTS damage: 60% → 55%

Spawn amount: 1–3 → 1–5 projectiles
Soulboom

Cooldown: 13s–11s → 10s

Applies slow if NULLFIELD is also taken

Pull range: 400 → 800

If target dies from burst, it drops double XP

Reworked mechanics: it now reduces your weapon range by -20%, your weapon deals extra damage per health missing from the target (max at 20% HP to deal additional +100% damage)

Reworked mechanics: it now temporarily increases you attack speed to 80% for 6s (ignore any additional buffs) after every 300 enemies you killed without taking any damage (The count will be reset upon taking damage)
Stairway Team
Hi Funguys,
We’re addressing some of the feedback and bugs found by the community in this update.
Winning a Run no longer removes your current Fire Curse (THE FIRE KING THANKS YOU FOR YOUR LOYALTY).
Rerolling Skills and Mutations can no longer show the same option.
Fixed rerolling Dew at max level resulting in a blank Skill Card offer.
Fixed equipped Pet icon sometimes not appearing correctly.
Fixed Keybind Hint sometimes not appearing correctly.
Fixed Douse Dew quest appearing when the player has no Fire Curse.
Fixed Chestnut from Elites sometimes dropping inside a building.
Fixed Soulboom: Sweet Release not dealing damage on dash.
Fixed inability to move the cursor in the Shroomshop when using a controller.
Fixed locking Dew at max level resulting in a UI softlock.
Fixed various VFX & SFX issues.
Fixed various UI issues.
✨ Thanks to all your feedback and bug reports, Funguys Swarm keeps getting better with every update. Keep the feedback coming — together we’ll keep making the game even juicier! 🍄💥
— Stairway Games
